boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UMD places for studying, gathering, art, music, recreation, and campus events.

cards.title: Kirby Student Center
cards.subtitle: 1120 Kirby Drive
cards.notes: Use the building directory to orient yourself, then check Kirby’s event listings for current meetings, tablings, and student-program activities.
cards.short_summary: The student center houses activities, organizations, services, and event space.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies Kirby as the heart of student life and says it is home to student organizations, the Multicultural Center, and spaces to hang out and study.
cards.source_title: Video Tours | Admissions | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Check Kirby’s current hours and event listings before visiting.

cards.title: Kathryn A. Martin Library
cards.subtitle: 416 Library Drive
cards.notes: Set up for independent or group work, or ask Library Services about study-room availability and reservations before relying on a room.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with individual and group study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s alumni history says the library includes study tables, individual and group study rooms, study carrels, and thirty group-study areas.
cards.source_title: Our History | Alumni Relations | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: The library is open to the public; confirm current building hours and room procedures before visiting.

cards.title: Bagley Nature Area
cards.subtitle: Northwest edge of the UMD campus
cards.notes: Choose a walking, running, birding, or ski-trail route that fits conditions; follow the posted trail guidance, including the biking restriction.
cards.short_summary: Campus forest, pond, and trails used for recreation and classes.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD describes Bagley as 59 acres of forest, pond, and open area used for walking, running, skiing, birding, and field-oriented classes.
cards.source_title: Bagley Nature Area | Recreational Sports Outdoor Program | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Parking rules apply during the school year; check trail conditions and seasonal guidance before heading out.

cards.title: Tweed Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: UMD campus arts district
cards.notes: Walk the current galleries at your own pace, and check the museum calendar before planning around a particular exhibition or installation.
cards.short_summary: UMD’s campus art museum, with exhibitions and a substantial collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tweed is UMD’s campus art museum and a resource for students; its exhibitions support close looking, teaching, learning, and research.
cards.source_title: Mission | Tweed Museum of Art | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: The museum is open year-round, though gallery access can change during installations and university breaks.

cards.title: Marshall W. Alworth Planetarium
cards.subtitle: 371 Marshall W. Alworth Hall
cards.notes: Check the public-show calendar and choose a show format that suits your group; Wednesday programs are listed as free on the planetarium site.
cards.short_summary: A campus planetarium with live interactive and full-dome shows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marshall W. Alworth Planetarium offers live interactive shows and full-dome presentations, including weekly public shows.
cards.source_title: Marshall W. Alworth Planetarium | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Public shows are scheduled weekly; ticketing applies to some Friday and Saturday shows, so verify the selected program first.

cards.title: North Shore Wall
cards.subtitle: Sports and Health Center
cards.notes: Review wall hours and reservation details, then bring or arrange the required access before joining a roped-climbing open session.
cards.short_summary: A two-story indoor climbing wall with varied routes and bouldering.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says the North Shore Wall in the Sports and Health Center has sport-lead routes, a simulated ice-climbing route, crack systems, a rappel ledge, and bouldering.
cards.source_title: Indoor Climbing Walls | Recreational Sports Outdoor Program | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Wall use has scheduled open hours, reservations, and pass requirements; verify current details before visiting.

cards.title: Multicultural Center
cards.subtitle: 233 Kirby Student Center
cards.notes: Stop in to connect with campus resources, student organizations, or programming, and use the center as a place for conversation and gathering.
cards.short_summary: A Kirby gathering space supporting inclusion, connection, and student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD describes the Multicultural Center as a gathering place and forum that supports student organizations, programs, discussion, and personal and academic support.
cards.source_title: Multicultural Center | Office of Diversity and Inclusion | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Located in Kirby Student Center; contact the Office of Diversity and Inclusion for program or resource details.

cards.title: Weber Music Hall
cards.subtitle: 1201 Ordean Court
cards.notes: Browse the Department of Music calendar for a recital or concert, and confirm ticket details for the specific performance before attending.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated music facility for student rehearsal, instruction, and performance.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says Weber Music Hall provides learning, rehearsal, and performance space for students and hosts performances for the broader Duluth community.
cards.source_title: Our History | Alumni Relations | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Concert schedules and ticket requirements vary by event; consult the Department of Music calendar.

cards.title: Kirby Ballroom
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Kirby Student Center
cards.notes: Watch Kirby Program Board and campus-event listings for public programs held here, then follow the event’s posted admission and arrival details.
cards.short_summary: A named Kirby event venue used for student programming and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s self-guided tour identifies the third-floor Kirby Ballroom as a site for Kirby Program Board programs, including open-mic, bingo, and craft events.
cards.source_title: UMD Self-Guided Tour Booklet | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: This is an event venue; access and any admission requirement depend on the scheduled program.

cards.title: Superior Dining Center
cards.subtitle: Near Kirby Student Center
cards.notes: Check the current dining schedule and entry options before meeting others here, especially around weekend or academic-break service changes.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining hall connected to the Kirby area.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s admissions video-tour page identifies the Superior Dining Center as an all-you-can-eat campus dining option.
cards.source_title: Video Tours | Admissions | University of Minnesota Duluth
cards.access_notes: Dining access requires a meal plan, payment, or another applicable entry arrangement; confirm current service hours.
